title: THE PILLBOX IS GENTLER
why: His note of 2026-10-09: the pillbox should deal less damage and/or fire slower, and have less health. Both are done: a shot does 17 instead of 22 and comes every 0.6 to 0.9 seconds instead of 0.42 to 0.66, about 23 damage a second where it was about 40, and its health drops from 1250 to 850, a third less. Its range is unchanged, so you can still hurt it from outside its reach.
now: The pillbox hits softer, fires slower and goes down faster.

edits.replacement: e.cd=rnd(0.60,0.90);   // v16.xx, his note: fires slower (was 0.42 to 0.66)
